fate_labels.B_PLAYED_THEN_SOLD_SAME_TURN: Reaches board, then removed before recruit ends (same turn).
fate_labels.C_PLAYED_THEN_SOLD_LATER: Survives recruit turn, then gets replaced later.
fate_labels.D_TARGET_SWITCH: Core survives, but infer_target changes before second-piece assembly.
fate_labels.E_SEED_PIECE_LOST: New core survives, but the original seeded core disappears.
fate_labels.F_TRANSFORMED_TRIPLED: Card identity changes through triple/discover mechanics.
fate_labels.G_TWO_CORE_TRANSIENT: Two cores coexist during an action-level state but not at end-of-recruit.

lifecycle_purchases.fate_label: Two cores coexist during an action-level state but not at end-of-recruit.

decision.recommended_next_step: Most fulfilled cores never reach the board — prioritize play-order and board-slot handling before retention or card-effect work.
